## Description

Confirm and file: data processing terms for Azure OpenAI and AI Speech (no training on customer data, abuse-monitoring configuration/exemption where available, data residency per region), sub-processor list update, and the internal rule "no training on customer data without separate lawful basis".

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** DPA/terms references and abuse-monitoring status are recorded per country in docs/compliance/ai-vendors.md.
- [ ] **AC2.** Trust centre sub-processor list is updated with region and purpose (30-day notice rule acknowledged).
- [ ] **AC3.** A configuration check verifies the AI resources live only in the approved region.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
